features: 42 dB ACTIVE NOISE CANCELLATION: Powerful ANC technology blocks out ambient noise, letting you enjoy your music and calls without any distractions.
HI-FI SOUND WITH DUAL DRIVERS: Experience premium audio quality powered by dual drivers for rich, detailed, and immersive sound performance.
LONG BATTERY LIFE: Enjoy up to 35.5 hours of total playback, with a quick charge feature that provides 5.5 hours of playback from just 10 minutes of charging.
CUSTOMISABLE SMART DIAL & DUAL DEVICE CONNECTION: The unique smart dial on the charging case offers customisable controls, while dual device connection lets you seamlessly switch between two devices.
DUST AND WATER RESISTANT: Built to withstand everyday use, these Bluetooth 5.3 TWS earbuds are dust and water resistant, making them ideal for workouts and outdoor activities.
description: Elevate your listening experience with these premium True Wireless Stereo (TWS) Earbuds, engineered for audiophiles and everyday users alike. Powered by Bluetooth 5.3, these earphones deliver a fast and stable wireless connection, keeping you seamlessly linked to your devices at all times. The dual-driver setup ensures Hi-Fi sound quality, producing rich, detailed audio across all frequencies. With an impressive 42 dB Active Noise Cancellation, unwanted background noise is effectively blocked, letting you focus entirely on your music or calls. The customisable Smart Dial on the charging case adds a unique, intuitive control element to your experience. Enjoy up to 35.5 hours of total playback, and with just 10 minutes of charging, get an additional 5.5 hours of listening time. The dual device connection feature allows seamless switching between two devices. Built-in microphones ensure clear, hands-free calling. Dust and water resistant, these earbuds are built to keep up with your active lifestyle. Charged conveniently via Type-C, staying powered up has never been easier.
